vibespace.consent.gate.strong: Isolation: strong (sandboxed worker, no network, no host environment).
vibespace.consent.gate.poc: Isolation: proof of concept on Windows. The shell gate stays closed until its CI checks pass.
vibespace.consent.gate.proxy: Tool network: goes through the broker-owned domain proxy. Only domains you allow are reachable.
vibespace.consent.gate.elevated: Elevated mode: this command runs WITHOUT a sandbox. You set this mode up explicitly; every command is asked separately.
vibespace.consent.gate.unavailable: Process execution is not available on this platform.
vibespace.consent.gate.unavailable.macos: Process execution is not available on macOS in this alpha. There is no fallback.
vs.model.title: Local model setup
vs.model.intro: Vibe Space can use a model that runs on this computer. Nothing is downloaded automatically.
vs.model.status.error: Could not read the model list
vs.model.hint.ollamaDown: Install and start Ollama, then run the command below.
vs.model.hint.ollamaPull: Run the command below in a terminal. The download is about 6 GB and only starts when you run it.
vs.model.hint.lmsDown: Start the LM Studio local server, then load Qwen3.5-9B.
vs.model.hint.lmsLoad: In LM Studio, download and load Qwen3.5-9B. It is not downloaded for you.
vs.model.localOnly: This check only talks to 127.0.0.1 on this computer.
vibespace.acp.launched: External agent started in the sandbox
vibespace.acp.noElevated: External agents never run with elevated access.
vibespace.computerUse.title: Computer use
vibespace.computerUse.unavailable: Computer use is unavailable. Linux preparation requires a feature gate and a reviewed platform adapter. Windows and macOS are disabled.
vibespace.computerUse.session: An external agent needs new consent at every session start and for every mouse, keyboard or capture action. Folder and MCP grants do not apply.
vibespace.computerUse.capture: Screen captures stay private review artifacts. They are not sent to the external agent automatically.

vibespace.acp.ui.name: Agent name
vibespace.acp.ui.unavailable: Native ACP bridge unavailable. Actions stay disabled.
vibespace.acp.ui.error: The action failed. Reload state before trying again.
vibespace.acp.ui.sessionLimit: Four active agents already. Close one before launching another.
vibespace.acp.ui.readFailed: State could not be read. Consent and prompts are disabled until refreshed.
vibespace.acp.ui.exactConsent: This choice applies only to the displayed request. It does not grant access to your project folder.
vibespace.acp.ui.limits: Limits: {sessions} active agents, {prompt} characters per prompt, latest {events} events.
vibespace.acp.ui.turn: Turn in progress. Consent remains available.
